prs.title: more proposal data updates
prs.author: michaelficarra
prs.body:
This aligns with https://github.com/tc39/data/pull/2, up to but not including the September 2026 plenary.

* 15 proposals gained Stage 2.7 reviewers, with 38 reviewer entries added.
* 4 proposals had champion lists updated, with 1 champion added and 4 removed.
* 15 proposals gained 19 presentation entries.
* 2 proposals had 3 duplicate presentation links removed.
* 3 proposals had existing presentation details or links corrected.
* 11 proposals had their canonical URLs corrected.
* 3 proposals had their Test262 coverage information updated.
* 21 inactive proposals had their status labels or rationales updated.
* 1 inactive proposal, "Time Zone Canonicalization", was added.
* 1 combined proposal entry, "Class fields, Private methods, and Static class features", had its title and component link labels revised.

**Disclaimer:** I used AI in the process of creating this PR.
